title: Fix monthly habit volumes: Plank Feb-based +15s progression, Squash fixed 45:00, and ticked-day monthly totals

requirements.summary: Adjust frontend optimistic compounding so Plank uses February as the base month (e.g., Feb 1:15) and applies +15 seconds per month after February without minutes/seconds drift.
acceptanceCriteria: When the stored/edited Plank value for February is 1:15, the computed/stored values for March and April are 1:30 and 1:45 respectively (and continue +15s for subsequent months).
The app no longer produces Plank monthly values like 16:00 or 31:00 as a result of the +15 increment (i.e., no minutes-vs-seconds bug).
Plank volume entries retain a seconds-accurate representation (e.g., timeString "1:15") so monthly totals can compute correctly at second granularity.
This progression rule is applied consistently in both backend compounding (Motoko) and frontend optimistic compounding (TypeScript) so values don’t ‘snap back’ after refresh.

file_operations.description: Update Plank-specific logic in computeCompoundedVolumeTracking to treat February (month index 1) as the base month for time targets and apply +15 seconds to months after February (Mar–Dec), while avoiding any minutes-vs-seconds conversion errors and keeping timeString seconds-accurate.

Ensure the optimistic update path for volume updates (useUpdateHabitVolume onMutate) continues to use the updated Plank compounding rule from habitModel so the UI does not 'snap back' after refresh/re-fetch.

requirements.summary: Ensure Squash remains a fixed 45:00 daily target across all months in the UI compounding logic and is used consistently in monthly totals calculations from ticked days.
acceptanceCriteria: For the Squash habit, the per-day volume displays as 45:00 for every month tab (Jan–Dec) once set, with no auto-increase.
If N days are ticked completed for Squash in a selected month, the Monthly total for Squash equals N × 45:00 (formatted correctly as time).
Backend persistence for Squash does not introduce future-month drift (e.g., later months remain 45:00 after refresh).

file_operations.description: Harden Squash handling in computeCompoundedVolumeTracking so the constant-volume rule is always applied (all months mirror the same entry), ensuring the timeString is normalized (M:SS) and never compounded month-to-month.

Verify the row display always reads the selected month's per-day volume via getVolumeDisplayString and monthly total via getMonthlyTotalVolume so Squash remains 45:00 on all month tabs and totals reflect ticked-day × 45:00.

requirements.summary: Compute and display monthly totals for all habits as (ticked days in selected month) × (per-day target for selected month), updating live on checkbox toggles and aggregating correctly in the Monthly Volume Summary.
acceptanceCriteria: Toggling a day checkbox for any habit updates that habit’s displayed “Monthly total” to reflect the new completed-days count × per-day volume for the selected month.
For time-based habits, monthly totals are computed with seconds accuracy when a timeString exists and are formatted as M:SS.
The Monthly Volume Summary aggregates totals using these same computed monthly totals (reps summed as numbers; time summed as seconds and formatted as M:SS).

file_operations.description: Fix monthly total calculations to always use the selected month’s per-day target and completed-day count, and for time-based habits compute totals in seconds using timeString when available even if minutes is missing; keep formatting as M:SS.
Confirm summary aggregation relies on getMonthlyTotalRaw (seconds for time, numbers for reps/numeric) and formats time totals as M:SS; ensure it reflects live updates after completion toggles.

Validate the completion-toggle optimistic update preserves immutability so HabitRow and MonthlyVolumeSummary re-render immediately, making monthly totals update live as (ticked days × per-day target).
